description: Sync the pages, chapters and books of the BookStack books you choose, one document per item. BookStack permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync the books you select from your BookStack instance. Each page is one document holding its text. Each chapter and each book is also one document, holding its description. Pages and chapters carry the id of their book and chapter, so a query can be limited to one book or chapter.

BookStack permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Items carry no link back to BookStack. Images and files on pages are not synced, and items deleted in BookStack stay in HydraDB.

notes: BookStack page, chapter, book and role permissions are not applied.

connect.auth: BookStack uses an API token, made of a token id and a token secret.

credentials.name: base_url
credentials.text: The root address of your BookStack instance.

steps.title: Create an API token
steps.text: In BookStack, create an API token and copy its id and secret. A page the token's user cannot read in full is synced with its title only.

steps.title: Select books
steps.text: HydraDB lists the books in the instance. Select the books to sync. Their chapters and pages come with them. To reach items older than 30 days, raise `lookback_days` when you select them.

connect.account: One connector reads one BookStack instance, as one API token.

sync.first_sync: Each selected book reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the books, chapters and pages updated since the last sync.
sync.edits: An updated item is read again and replaces its document. A page's content is read again with it.
sync.deletes: Deleted items are not removed. A page, chapter or book deleted in BookStack stays searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: updated_at
shared_attributes.text: When the item was last updated, written as the `Updated` line. Sets the result date.

shared_attributes.name: created_at
shared_attributes.text: When the item was created. Sets the result date only when the update time is missing. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_type
shared_attributes.text: `pages`, `chapters` or `books`. Limits a query to one kind of item. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: owned_by
shared_attributes.text: The BookStack user id of the item's owner. It does not restrict access.

shared_attributes.name: owned_by_name
shared_attributes.text: The owner's name, when it can be found. A search does not match it.

documents.name: Pages
documents.title: The page name. A page with no name is titled `BookStack page` and its id.
documents.text: The page content as plain text, with its title and last-updated time. If the page's content could not be read, the title stands in for it.
documents.date: When the page was last updated, else when it was created.
documents.files: None. Images and files on pages are not synced.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_id
attributes.text: The page's numeric BookStack id. Picks out one page. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_book_id
attributes.text: The id of the book that holds the page. Limits a query to one book. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_chapter_id
attributes.text: The id of the chapter that holds the page, when it is in one. Limits a query to one chapter. Not searchable.

documents.name: Chapters
documents.one_document: One chapter's name and description. Its pages are their own documents.
documents.title: The chapter name. A chapter with no name is titled `BookStack chapter` and its id.
documents.text: The chapter description, or the title when there is none, with the last-updated time.
documents.date: When the chapter was last updated, else when it was created.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_id
attributes.text: The chapter's numeric BookStack id. Picks out one chapter, and matches `additional_metadata.bookstack_chapter_id` on its pages. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_book_id
attributes.text: The id of the book that holds the chapter. Limits a query to one book. Not searchable.

documents.name: Books
documents.one_document: One book's name and description. Its chapters and pages are their own documents.
documents.title: The book name. A book with no name is titled `BookStack book` and its id.
documents.text: The book description, or the title when there is none, with the last-updated time.
documents.date: When the book was last updated, else when it was created.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bookstack_id
attributes.text: The book's numeric BookStack id. Picks out one book, and matches `additional_metadata.bookstack_book_id` on its chapters and pages. Not searchable.

example_searches: What does the runbook page say about restoring backups?
Which pages in the Operations book mention VPN access?
What is the Onboarding book about?

connections: No links between items. A page's book and chapter are kept as filters, not as graph links.
No links to items in other tools.
people: No people are attached. The owner is kept with the item only.
graph.from_text: The page text and the book and chapter descriptions.

not_synced: Items last updated before the `lookback_days` window on the first sync.
Images and files attached to pages.
A link back to the item in BookStack.
Deletions: deleted items stay in HydraDB.
